message.reasoning:
New York is listed at $200 but bidding has already hit $325. Since p1 already controls St. Charles and St. James plus the light blue set minus Oriental, letting them take New York would give them two of three oranges while Tennessee sits unclaimed — risky, but Tennessee would still need to be auctioned separately. With $1300 on hand, overpaying stings, but blocking the orange monopoly and picking up a blocker property of my own seems worth it.

$350 still leaves me with $950, and it also drains p1's cash reserves. I'll push the bid to $350 and see how they respond.
